quality.review_scope: Independent audit of both supplied main pages, Figures 1–3 and the 12-entry bibliography passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Both supplied main pages are covered; SI and cited full papers remain unreviewed.
Autoclave capacity, absolute ethylenediamine volume, pressure, ramp, stirring and cooling duration are unreported. The 90% value is vessel filling, not solution concentration.
Starting-material grades/suppliers, distilled-water wash amount/repetitions, filter specification, vacuum pressure and product yield are unreported.
No source-measured atomic coordinates, space-group refinement or verified unit-cell model supplied. Source-printed cell constant and XPS reference-unit anomalies are retained without repair.
Independent source audit passed; presentation refinements remain pending.
Unit-cell/finite-particle geometry remains presentation pending; source figures and separately bound conceptual stage art do not establish coordinates.
conflicts: Printed cubic cell constant: Preserve 57.4 nm literally with a unit/scale anomaly warning. No correction or unit-cell model is inferred.
Printed XPS charge-reference unit: Retain the printed kV reference as an unresolved source anomaly; do not silently substitute eV.
